WITH actual AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quota AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota_sales
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
)
SELECT
    a.StoreKey,
    st.StoreName,
    a.actual_sales,
    q.quota_sales,
    a.actual_sales / nullif(q.quota_sales, 0) AS attainment_ratio
FROM actual a
JOIN quota q ON a.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
JOIN retail.DimStore st ON a.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
ORDER BY attainment_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
